name: pmat
description: Project Analysis and Intelligence Modeling Toolkit

tools.name: analyze_complexity
tools.description: Analyze cyclomatic and cognitive complexity for source files.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

top_files.description: Return only the top N most-complex files

tools.name: analyze_satd
tools.description: Detect self-admitted technical debt (TODO, FIXME, HACK markers) in source code.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

include_tests.description: Include test files and #[cfg(test)] blocks (default: false, matching `pmat analyze satd`)

tools.name: analyze_dead_code
tools.description: Find unreachable or unused code (functions, types, or modules).

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

include_tests.description: Include test files when searching for dead code

tools.name: analyze_dag
tools.description: Generate a project dependency graph (call graph, import graph, inheritance, or full dependency DAG).

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

dag_type.description: Dependency graph type to generate (default: full-dependency)

tools.name: analyze_deep_context
tools.description: Run the full deep-context analysis pipeline (AST, complexity, churn, dead code) over the given paths.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

tools.name: analyze_big_o
tools.description: Classify the Big-O time complexity of functions in the given paths.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

top_files.description: Return only the top N files by algorithmic complexity

tools.name: analyze_reachability
tools.description: Report tracked .rs files that no compilation unit reaches — orphaned modules that compile to nothing and whose tests never run.

project_path.description: Project root to analyze (the directory holding Cargo.toml / the git worktree)

tools.name: analyze_hardcoded_paths
tools.description: Find machine-specific absolute paths baked into source (a user's home, a nix store hash, a build root) — correct where they were written, inert everywhere else.

project_path.description: Project root to analyze (the directory holding Cargo.toml / the git worktree)

tools.name: analyze_vacuous_tests
tools.description: Find #[test] functions that cannot fail — no assertion, an assertion over constants, or a body that silently returns when a fixture is missing.

project_path.description: Project root to analyze (the directory holding Cargo.toml / the git worktree)

tools.name: quality_gate
tools.description: Run the `pmat quality-gate --checks all` suite (complexity, dead code, SATD, entropy, security, duplicates, coverage, documentation sections, provability) plus a TDG score against the given paths. Any check a path could not answer is named in `not_measured` and, with its reason, in `checks.not_run`.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

strict.description: Fail the gate on any violation (no tolerance)

file.description: Check only this single file instead of the paths list

tools.name: quality_check_content
tools.description: Grade proposed file content against the project's quality gate (complexity, SATD, docs, lint) and return it with a verdict. Never touches the filesystem: hand the returned content to your own file tool, or let the harness PreToolUse hook gate the change.

file_path.description: Path the content is destined for (decides the language and the project's pmat.toml)

content.description: The proposed file content to grade

tools.name: quality_proxy
tools.description: Grade proposed file content against the project's quality gate (complexity, SATD, docs, lint) and return it with a verdict. Never touches the filesystem: hand the returned content to your own file tool, or let the harness PreToolUse hook gate the change.

file_path.description: Path the content is destined for (decides the language and the project's pmat.toml)

content.description: The proposed file content to grade

tools.name: pdmt_deterministic_todos
tools.description: Generate deterministic, quality-enforced todo lists from a list of requirements.

requirements.description: Requirements to convert into deterministic actionable todos

tools.name: git_operation
tools.description: Query git working-tree status for the given repository path.

path.description: Path to the git repository to query

tools.name: generate_context
tools.description: Generate project context (file tree + optional dependency graph) for LLM/agent consumption.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

tools.name: scaffold_project
tools.description: Produce a high-level project summary scaffold for the given paths.

paths.description: Filesystem paths (files or directories) to analyze

tools.name: pmat_query_code
tools.description: Search code functions by natural language query with TDG quality filtering. Returns semantically ranked results with complexity, fault patterns, and call graph context.

query.description: Natural language search query describing the code intent.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

min_grade.description: Minimum TDG grade filter (A+ is best). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: pmat_get_function
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific function by its ID. Returns full function metadata including source code, quality metrics, and SATD markers.

tools.name: pmat_find_similar
tools.description: Find functions similar to a reference function. Useful for finding related code, potential duplicates, or implementations of similar patterns.

function_id.description: Function ID to find similar functions for

limit.description: Maximum number of similar functions (default: 5, max: 20)

tools.name: pmat_index_stats
tools.description: Get statistics about the code index including function counts, quality distribution, and index health.

rebuild.description: Rebuild the index before returning stats (default: false)
